title: Flags-on fan path passes screen-px band where world-px is expected (end_apex, draw_fan_stub) and min() mixes world and screen units
evidence:
band := link_width_capped(v, topo, bundles, u32(bi)) * v.scale  [line 967, screen px]
...
band_w := band // the covenant-capped width (LOOK §3 — the fan matches the drawn ribbon)
apex_a, anchors_a := end_apex(v, topo, bundles, u32(bi), 0, b_world, band_w)
...
stub_w := min(band_world(v, anc.tier, 1), band) * 0.6 // the member's own narrow read, covenant-capped
...
draw_fan_stub(v, anc.pos, apex_a, stub_w, stub_col)
--- wire_path.odin:338-342: end_apex :: proc(v: ^View, topo: ^pp.Topology, bundles: ^pp.Bundles, bi: u32, end: u32, other_world: rl.Vector2, band_w: f32) ... r := puck_rim_world(v, pc)
target := r + band_w * 0.5
--- view.odin:1091-1095: draw_fan_stub :: proc(v: ^View, from, to: rl.Vector2, width_world: f32, col: rl.Color) {
...
rl.DrawLineEx(a, b, width_world * v.scale, col)
detail: end_apex/doc say world px (r = puck_rim_world); band is link_width_capped*v.scale (screen). At scale>1 the apex is pushed band*scale/2 too far; min(world,screen) + draw_fan_stub's internal *v.scale double-scales stubs. Pre-diff call passed band_world.
recommended_fix: Pass the uncapped world-px covenant width: band_w := link_width_capped(v, topo, bundles, u32(bi)) and stub_w := min(band_world(v, anc.tier, 1), link_width_capped(v, topo, bundles, u32(bi))) * 0.6.

title: Assist route-glow still computes its flags-on path from the uncapped band_world while wire_paths_compute now uses the capped width — glow and stroke diverge on clamped bundles
evidence:
assist.odin:436 and 439: band_w := band_world(v, bundles.bundle_tier[bi], int(bundles.bundle_count[bi]))
--- wire_path.odin:604-609 (changed hunk): // the covenant width: the drawn path's clearances must match the
// CAPPED stroke (a clamped bundle detours for the width it DRAWS)
band := link_width_capped(v, topo, bundles, u32(bi))
append(&paths, wire_path_compute(v, topo, bundles, u32(bi), band))
detail: Before the diff both sides used uncapped band_world (identical polylines); now the world stroke detours/apexes on the capped clearance while the assist glow's path keeps the uncapped clearance, so the preview glow stops hugging the drawn ribbon for clamped fat bundles.
recommended_fix: Use link_width_capped(v, topo, bundles, bi) for band_w in draw_glow_edge's two flags-on wire_path_compute calls.

title: Sprite sheet load failure (ok=false, zeroed bboxes) drives sprite_puck_target to 0, so the covenant clamps every router-anchored bundle to width 0 — all links vanish on the documented primitive-fallback path
detail: With the sheet unloaded, bboxes[idx][2]=0 is the numerator (base=110 rescues only the denominator), so puck draw size 0 → cap 0 → draw_bundles renders zero-width strokes. Pre-diff band_width had no bbox dependence; the View contract documents ok=false primitive fallback as a supported state.
recommended_fix: Make node_draw_size_world fall back to the committed bbox defaults (like base=110) or skip the clamp when v.sprites.ok is false, so the primitive-fallback path keeps visible links.
